sentences.text:
Lalmani Dohar
 Versus
 Amit Kumar Kabirpanthi And Others

Appearance:
 Shri Kapil Patwardhan - Advocate for appellant.
Ms. Asghari Khan - Advocate for respondent.

None for the respondent Nos.1 and 2 inspite of service of n
 Order
Heard on admission.

This appeal has been filed by the appellant - claimant under Section 173 (1) of the Motor Vehicle Act,
1988 for enhancement of compensation Rs.7,00,000/- against the award dated 26.09.2023 passed in M.A.C.C. No.3737 of 2020 by 14th Additional Member, M.A.C.T., Jabalpur, district Jabalpur,
M.P.
The court fees of Rs.17,500/-is paid.
The motor accident dated 15.10.2020 has awarded compensation of Rs.5,40,443/-.
It is submitted that on the date of accident the minimum wage was Rs.8400/- but the Tribunal has taken Rs.6625/- in para 32 of the award.

It is also submitted that there was disability of 70% which is mentioned in para No.26 of the award but the Tribunal has taken disability of 8% as per in para No.27 of the award, NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:17421 2 MA-6451-2023 therefore, seeks enhancement.
Learned counsel for the respondent supported the award.

It seems that award has been erroneously calculated, looking to the disability factor and minimum age factor accordingly this appeal is partly allowed and amount is enhanced by Rs.56,83,44/- and calculation is below as :-
 P.D./Injuries :- Rs.151368/-
 (6625+40%x12x8%x17)
Lalmani Dohar vs Amit Kumar Kabirpanthi on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40607060/
1  Pain & suffering Rs.15,000/-
 Medical Expenses Rs.346200/-
 Attendant  +
 Special Diet Rs.8,000/-
 +
 Transport  Loss of income  during treatment Rs.19875/-
__________________________________________________ Total Rs. Rs.568344/-
On the enhanced amount, the rate of interest would be 6% per annum and not 9% as award in para 42 of the award from the date of filing of claim case till payment.

(AVANINDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE Prar Lalmani Dohar vs Amit Kumar Kabirpanthi on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40607060/
